features.name: Divination Savant
features.desc: You copy Divination spells in half the time and for half the gold.

features.name: Portent
features.desc: When you finish a Long Rest, you roll two d20s and record the results; you can replace any d20 roll made by a creature you can see with one of them.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.desc: When you cast a Divination spell of level 2 or higher, you regain a spell slot of a lower level.

features.name: The Third Eye
features.desc: As an action, you gain one benefit: Darkvision, seeing into the Ethereal Plane, reading any language, or greater sight range.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.desc: Portent gives you three d20s instead of two.
